title: Home Delivery Charge Amount on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders — Billing Office Determination
content:
**Determination.** The delivery charge for a delivered order in a Ridgeline Special Order Services program whose deposit at order is 50 percent is the program's home delivery fee, billed once as a home delivery fee line and stated in US dollars rounded to the nearest cent. An order linked to an installation contract carries no home delivery charge.

## Terms used

- **The program's home delivery fee** is the figure of the order's program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services home delivery tariff.
- **Linked to an installation contract** means the order records a linked Ridgeline Installation Services contract.

## Decision table

| Order linked to an installation contract | Delivery charge |
|---|---|
| no | the program's home delivery fee |
| yes | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program fees)

| Program fee | Linked | Delivery charge |
|---|---|---|
| 99.00 | no | 99.00 |
| 149.00 | no | 149.00 |
| 149.00 | yes | none |

## Basis questions

**Is the charge billed per delivery attempt?** The charge is billed once on the delivered order, as one home delivery fee line.
